power_chord.name: Power Chords
rules: Use root-fifth-octave voicing without introducing a major or minor third.
Learn onset, duration, inversion and strum offsets from the matching Factory element.
Do not convert a melodic or clean-guitar track into Power Chords solely from its program number.
Both oscillator layers sound from velocity 1 through 127; velocity controls dynamics only and must not select mute, harmonic, slap or slide articulation.
Prefer Var3/Var4, rock-oriented fills and endings; keep Var1 sparse unless Factory evidence says otherwise.
Velocity 1 through 87 selects the mute oscillator layer.
Velocity 88 through 127 selects the distortion/harmonic oscillator layer.
C7 through G9 are absolute noise triggers and must never be transposed or chord-harmonized.

fill_policy.fill1: short transition preserving the current groove skeleton
fill_policy.fill2: higher-energy transition allowed to add toms, open hat and crash preparation
fill_policy.break: intentional reduction or stop; never fill every empty subdivision
fill_policy.selection: match meter, grouping, tempo family, drum kit mapping and measured variation intensity
